title: ThreadSafe module rule (PrestaShop 9)
description: One file per module: plugins/prestashop9/resources/modules/<module>.json or <rules dir>/<module>.json. Table names are written without the table prefix. Rules are data only; there are no handlers. The loader (ModuleRules) validates the same constraints and refuses a rule that does not fit.

module.description: The module's name; the file is named <module>.json.

domainColumns.description: Columns the generic engine is told more about.

form.description: Only this structured format is tried; without it the engine detects the format.

bare.description: The column holds bare host names, which are replaced as well.

skipTables.description: Log or cache tables of the module the content replacement skips.

glob.description: Relative to the shop root, no '..'. 'delete' only below modules/<module>/, var/cache/, var/logs/, cache/ and img/tmp/.

action.description: delete: removed with the caches; replace: the domain is replaced in this text file.

deactivate.description: Deactivate the module in dev mode.
